{{Top|leg}}
The '''Talisman of Iron Fists''' was a device created by a society of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force wielding]] warriors. It was used to turn the body into a weapon by channeling [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] into the body, making it "hard as steel."<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
